root_cause: profile.default in .config/nextest.toml capped the CLI-subprocess tests at 60s x terminate-after 2 = 120s (and 90s x 3 = 270s for test_pattern_discovery), but each spawns the debug CLI binary once per command, so runtime tracks machine speed. Measured uncapped, idle, sequential on the slowest dev box: test_bulk_operations 134.5s, test_relationship_full_cycle 179.0s, test_pattern_discovery 400.5s. The tests were passing with every assertion logged before the kill. Running them idle and single-threaded did not help, so this was a hard cap shortfall, not load flakiness.
resolution: profile.default gained whole-binary overrides (binary(cli_workflows), binary(relationship_command_tests)) with period 240s x terminate-after 2 (kill at 480s, above the slowest measured test). The redundant per-test default override for test_pattern_discovery was removed because when several overrides match the binary-level one wins, so two entries with different caps made the effective limit unpredictable. profile.ci is untouched (retries twice, passes on its runners). Verified with cargo nextest run --all: 3955/3955 passed, exit 0, slowest test 374.7s. PR #1029.
